notes.title: Petit Island - Patch 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
[p]
Hello, everyone![/p][p]A brand-new update has just rained down on [b][i]Petit Island[/i][/b]! [b]Version 1.0.0.6[/b] is now available on [b]Steam[/b], bringing an exciting mix of fixes and fresh content.
[/p][p]This update adds new interactable objects in the playground and introduces improvements to Pako Quest, making its objectives clearer and more streamlined. We’ve also fixed several issues with menus and controller navigation, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience overall.
[/p][p]We hope this update makes your island journeys even more delightful. Be sure to check out the patch notes below for all the details![/p][p][/p][h3]Petit Island Version 1.0.0.6 Patch Notes:

[b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][p]🌴 Cannot navigate with controller on shaded objects in the Journal.[/p][p]🌴 Menus cannot be closed after Lily gets teleported while any menu is open.[/p][p]🌴 Update of word “Uitgang” in Dutch.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][p]🐢 Playground updates: added new interactable objects (swing, slide and spring banallama).[/p][p]🐢 Pako Quest Improvements: quest objectives simplified.[/p][p]🐢 Remove petable Fox Carrot near Pako’s House. 

Thanks,
-SOEDESCO & Xelo Games[/p]

notes.title: Petit Island - Patch 1.0.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42078360/6824aadf2045145ab1a6a25249f1e78105d0c380.jpg[/img]
Hello, everyone!

We hope your week is going wonderfully! And to make it even better, here’s the latest [b][i]Petit Island [/i][/b]update! [b]Version 1.0.0.5[/b] is now live on [b]Steam[/b], bringing exciting new features and improvements to level up your island experience.

This update addresses several issues, including mission and task tracking errors when switching game languages, as well as audio crackling issues on certain devices, and more. But the real excitement comes with new ways to explore and interact with the world! With the new update, you can now purchase new rideable mounts, new wildlife has also arrived on the island, and you can finally share some love by petting the animals. Additionally, you can now play with soccer balls and beach balls scattered around the environment whenever you’re in the mood for a little fun.

We can’t wait for you to dive into this update and enjoy all the new additions! Make sure to check all the details in the patch notes below.

[h2]Petit Island 1.0.0.5 Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]

🌴 Fixed an audio crackling issue on certain devices.
🌴 Resolved a navigation bug on the Menagerie page when it was full of items.
🌴 Corrected various grammar issues.
🌴Fixed an issue preventing navigation using the shoulder button when the map was hidden.
🌴 Resolved a bug where the Journal could not be closed in certain instances.
🌴 Improved navigation behavior on the Selling/Buying page.
🌴 Fixed a camera issue with the Berrylama, preventing it from clipping into its body.
🌴 Addressed a bug where Tony Bananalama persisted post-game.
🌴 Fixed an issue causing certain NPCs to get stuck while walking.
🌴 Adjusted UI legend text and images to improve spacing.
🌴 Fixed mission and task tracking errors when changing the game language.
🌴 Players can now continue the game even if they haven't completed the EFN Homage side quest.
🌴 Resolved a bug that allowed fishing in vertical landscapes.
🌴 Fixed an issue where the cursor disappeared when using a controller in the Journal.
🌴 Adjusted the success criteria for the "Catch All Fish" achievement to exclude trash items (boots, sponges, cans) to prevent confusion.
🌴 Fixed a bug causing the Entomologist and Ichthyologist introduction dialogue to repeat.
🌴 Resolved an issue where the interaction button appeared above a digging hole in Chapter 09.

[h3]Updates:[/h3]
🐢 New Rideable Mounts: Flamango and Lizard Dragon can now be purchased from the shop.
🐢 New Wildlife: Chickens now roam the world.
🐢 New Interactive Objects: Players can now interact with soccer balls and beach balls.
🐢 Pettable Animals: Some animals in the world can now be interacted with and petted.
🐢 Sitting Feature: Lily can now sit on chairs to enjoy the scenery.
🐢 Banallama Ability Update: Banallama can now jump.
🐢 Volcano Island Terrain Adjustments: Improved accessibility to legendary bugs.
🐢Phone Left Cinematic Change: Now plays as an animation instead of a cinematic (based on player feedback).
🐢Updated Sound Assets: The shocked emoji sound has been modified (based on player feedback).
🐢 Environmental Enhancements: Additional props have been added to the world.
🐢Bug Catching Update: Sneaking while catching bugs is now less sensitive (based on player feedback).
🐢 UI/UX Improvements: Updated the Furniture and Rideable pages in the Journal to help players better track collectible items.
🐢 NPC Relocations: Some NPCs have been repositioned.
🐢Geocache Adjustments: The geocache for the Scout Mission has been relocated.

Thanks,
-Xelo Games & SOEDESCO

notes.title: Petit Island - Patch 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, everyone![/h2]

Today, we're excited to announce that we've just rolled out the latest update for [b][i]Petit Island[/i][/b] on [b]Steam[/b]! [b]Version 1.0.0.3[/b] is now live and it comes with several important fixes to ensure an uninterrupted experience in [i]Petit Island[/i]. 

Specifically, we've addressed the crash issues during the base building and radio tower quests. Additionally, The hide and seek and gather fish side quests are now correctly marked as complete once finished. We've also refactored the save implementation to prevent any save issues, and various fixes to known issues have been made to improve your overall experience.

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback! Stay tuned for more updates soon!

[b][h3]Petit Island V1.0.0.3 (Steam):[/h3][/b]
[b]Fixes: [/b]
🌴 Fix issue crash when doing base building.
🌴 Fix crash issue when doing radio tower quest.
🌴 Fix few side quest comes up even though it already completed.
🌴 Refactor save implementation to prevent save issues.
🌴 Fix on multiple accessible mark on the map.
🌴 Fix issue on unconnected controllers shows as connected controllers.
🌴 Fix hide and seek side quest not completed, when it already completed.
🌴 Fix issue on gather fish side quest not completed, when it already completed.
🌴 Fix issue sprinkler not marked properly during load on save game.
🌴 Fix issue on animation on Pako in graveyard during load game.
🌴 Fix issue food vendor can be interacted even though the side quest not started.
🌴 Fix issue turtle suddenly turn invisible when completing flip turtle side quest.
🌴 Address stuck issue because of geometry bug.
🌴 Address issue playing conversation at the same time causing softlock.

Thanks,
-Xelo Games & SOEDESCO
